question: Can the flat producer observation be replaced by a domain-owned, entity-factored producer view (capacity-type rows, product rows, input-product rows, recipe-edge relations) behind a versioned, opt-in env encoder, passing row-order / product-relabel / capacity-relabel permutation gates and staying checkpoint-incompatible with flat_v1 — without touching the producer command or the production auction?
scope: observation contract only; no learned/planning controller, no training, no cloud run. Reservation rows and requestor-side replenishment EMAs deferred. Planner = EXP-0010B, learned scorer = EXP-0010C, size-holdout = EXP-0010D.

domain: domain/metrics.py: capacity_demand_pressure, restore/upgrade effect+cost, downstream_demand_pressure, active_reservation_qty, blocked_reservation_qty
domain/producer_view.py: ProducerEntityView + build_producer_entity_view (ordered row lists, relations keyed by row position, no cycle progress)
env: EnvSpec.producer_obs_version (default 1=flat_v1, opt-in 2=entity) + producer_entity_obs_dim + PRODUCER_* width constants
encode_producing_entity(spec, view, cycle_progress): globals + padded/masked rows + relation planes + trailing cycle progress; order-equivariant (consumes view row order verbatim)
config_fingerprint / build_spec threaded with producer_obs_version (v1 fingerprints byte-identical to history; v2 distinguished)

acceptance.baseline_preserved: command/auction untouched; full suite green; stock_aware white-box episode byte-identical with flag off vs on
acceptance.permutation_gates: row-order equivariance, product-relabeling, capacity-relabeling all pass on the encoder
acceptance.versioned_contract: config_fingerprint(v2) != (v1); producing_obs_dim differs; flat_v1 checkpoint dim != entity dim

review_fixes: reserved_ratio: divide reserved capacity by CURRENT usable capacity (Res/C), not max — a degraded producer's reservations block more of what it can use (producer_view.py).

producer action mechanics: entity globals now carry the 4 producer-global action economics the cap rows don't hold per-type (max_replenish, replenish_cost_per_unit, inventory_expansion increases+cost, ADR-0044) — PRODUCER_GLOBAL_FEATURES 8->12. Without them two configs differing only in replenish/expansion cost encoded identically while decode/funding act differently.
deviations: Did NOT add requested_capacity_by_type to the positional ProducingAgentView dataclass: the view builder reads the ProducingAgent directly (mirroring orderer_view), so the positional dataclass is left untouched.

Relations carry the two non-degenerate recipe edges (product->capacity, product->input); the all-1 producer_owns/can_make/uses_input masks are implied by row existence + the per-row active mask, not stored.

Two flat globals intentionally dropped from the entity view (anti-goal): all-order-product open demand (_open_demand_features) and all-producer summary (_producer_summary, 2P). The view keeps only this producer's products/demand; cross-producer context, if needed, becomes a masked peer-producer row block in a later slice.
InputRow requestor-side replenishment EMAs deferred (no telemetry source; EconomyTelemetry tracks production/routing/demand only).
